title: Nano onboard pathways and incident scenarios notes
content:
Purpose:
A very small, pragmatic sketch for a zero-friction SDK first-run (0-5 minutes) + a compact incident/telemetry checklist to pair with it. Goal is something we can ship into the playground, demo in a 10-minute call, and use as the canonical lab for telemetry probes.

Audience:
- Engineers trying Redwood SDK for the first time (polyglot: JS/Python/Go).
- Solutions engineers doing 1:1 demos.
- Internal integrators validating telemetry and failure modes.

Assumptions (quick):
- user has an API key and a sandbox project in Console (quick-create flow exists).
- tiny sample app repo with 3 files: README, quickstart.{js,py,go}, .env.template
- default model pinned to a low-cost variant (for demo throughput).

Zero-touch first-run flow (0-5 min):
1) git clone samplekit && cd samplekit
2) cp .env.template .env && set REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxxxx (demo: auto-insert from console copy button)
3) npm ci / pip install -r requirements.txt / go run init (one-liner documented)
4) node quickstart.js  OR  python quickstart.py  OR  go run quickstart.go
5) App prints: `Hello Redwood! token_cost=12 latency_ms=140 request_id=abc123` and opens a local /play endpoint.

Developer-facing UX details to include in docs:
- What success looks like on the first call: presence of `request_id`, token cost, model name, region.
- Quick explainers for error classes: client auth (401), payload validation (400/422), rate limit (429), server transient (5xx).
- Copyable troubleshooting commands: curl sample, repro with --debug flag, where logs land (~/redwood/logs).

Telemetry & probes (minimal required):
- On every request emit a probe: {request_id, model, seq_len, tokens_out, latency_ms, sdk_version, env}
- Local dev mode: write probe to stdout + local file ./rdw-probes.log (rotate after 5MB).
- CI smoke: small script to run 10 quick requests, assert median latency < 500ms and error rate 0%.
- Alert hints: if token cost > 10x baseline or steady 5xx spikes -> auto open ticket template.

Incident scenarios (walkthroughs for on-call / integrator):
- Case A: 401 after token rotation
  - Symptoms: first request fails with 401, subsequent requests same.
  - Quick repro: run with old key in .env.
  - Mitigation: swap to new key, restart app; add client-side key check with TTL and clearer error message.
  - Slack template to notify SRE: include request_id list, sample logs, account id.

- Case B: Persistent 429s during demo burst
  - Symptoms: many 429s from hosted API while demo users push parallel requests.
  - Mitigation steps: fallback to smaller model variant, enable backoff in SDK (exponential with jitter), surface a UI banner: "Degraded to low-cost model".

- Case C: Degraded latency (KV cache miss storm)
  - Symptoms: tail latency spikes, pattern shows increasing seq_len and cache-misses.
  - Mitigation: enable short-lived prefix caching in SDK, throttle concurrency at client, add temporary routing to Dedicated pool if customer has reservation.

Quickstart checklist (ship-ready minimum):
- [ ] One-liner install + run across three languages
- [ ] .env.template + instructions to obtain API key in Console (deep link)
- [ ] Built-in --debug output + link to probe log location
- [ ] CI smoke script and GH Action to run on merge to main/samplekit
- [ ] A single-slide flow diagram for SEs (copyable into decks)
- [ ] Retry/backoff defaults (opt-out) documented with examples

Docs skeleton to write (short fragments to replace later):
- Quickstart overview (30s)
- What to expect on first call (table: field -> meaning)
- Troubleshooting matrix (error -> cause -> action)
- Telemetry reference (probe schema + retention guidance)
- Incident playbooks (three scenarios above, with checklists)

Open questions / decisions:
- Do we auto-populate the API key in samplekit via a console copy + clipboard flow, or leave manual? (SEs prefer auto; security prefers explicit copy)
- Default telemetry retention for samplekit logs (30d vs 7d) — storage tradeoffs for playground users.
- Should CI smoke gate be required for samplekit main branch? (helps quality, small flakiness risk)

Immediate next steps (short):
- Liam: spin up samplekit repo skeleton + GH Action template (due: 2025-11-14)
- Marcos: draft the telemetry probe schema and log format (due: 2025-11-11)
- Priya: write the single-slide SE flow + 2-min demo script (due: 2025-11-12)
- Aisha: wire Console deep-link for API key quickcopy and draft copy for Console UX team (due: 2025-11-13)

Notes to self / rough UX copy snippets:
- "Run the Quickstart in 60 seconds — no config beyond your API key."
- "If you see 5xx, run `rdw quickstart --debug` and paste logs into the support form."

References / links to attach later:
- GH samplekit repo (placeholder)
- Linear tickets for telemetry and samplekit infra
- Console deep-link mockups in Figma

End (scratchpad).

-- a few quick editorial style notes: keep examples tiny, prefer concrete numbers in demos (latency, tokens), and model names should be abstracted to "default-demo-variant" to avoid churn during rollouts.
